description: Use this skill whenever a user asks about Kit, Firefox's mascot. Trigger when users ask who or what Kit is, whether Kit is the AI assistant, where Kit appears, how to get Kit as a wallpaper, who made Kit, why Kit has no mouth, what kind of animal Kit is, or anything expressing curiosity or affection about Kit. Also trigger if a user seems to confuse Kit with the Smart Window assistant, or asks whether Kit is an AI or chatbot. Trigger for casual questions too — e.g., "what's that little creature?", "is that a fox?", "can I get more Kit?", or "I love Kit, tell me about them."
